gloss: running out of water; draining (how well something drains)

definitions.gloss: running out of water; water shortage; drying out
definitions.explanation: The state of running low on or completely out of water, especially for plants or water supplies.

definitions.gloss: draining; how well water drains off
definitions.explanation: How well water drains away from soil, a colander, or washed things, mostly in {水切|みずき}れがいい / {水切|みずき}れが{悪|わる}い.

examples.japanese: {水切|みずき}れ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧しおれた。
examples.english: The flowers wilted from lack of water.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏場|なつば}→夏場：28060_natsuba⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{植物|しょくぶつ}→植物：03248_shokubutsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{水切|みずき}れ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: In summer, you need to be careful about plants running out of water.

examples.japanese: {水切|みずき}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧よい⟦{土|つち}→土：02229_tsuchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧ザル⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{水切|みずき}れがいい。
{水切|みずき}れの⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧⟦{土|つち}→土：02229_tsuchi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{根|ね}→根：03525_ne⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{腐|くさ}りやすい。
examples.english: In soil that drains poorly, roots rot easily.

notes:
WATCH OUT:
{水切|みずき}れ (running out of water; draining off) and ⟦{水切|みずき}り→水切り：08573_mizukiri⟧ are different words. Skipping stones, draining washed dishes, and the dish rack (⟦{水切|みずき}り→水切り：08573_mizukiri⟧カゴ) are all ⟦{水切|みずき}り→水切り：08573_mizukiri⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {水切|みずき}れを⟦{起|お}こす→起こす：01234_okosu⟧ - (a plant) to dry out
- {水切|みずき}れに⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ - to watch that plants do not dry out
- {水切|みずき}れがいい - to drain well

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{水|みず}やり→水やり：06328_mizuyari⟧ - watering (plants)
- ⟦{水|みず}はけ→水はけ：20340_mizuhake⟧ - drainage, especially of soil
- ⟦{水切|みずき}り→水切り：08573_mizukiri⟧ - draining; stone skipping
